None of the above

Inhibits a novel stimuli from standing out for inspection among already existing stimuli

Has survival value in quickly helping to identify among stimuli as to which is friend and which is foe

options: It greatly intensifies the effects of sensitization
It allows organisms to ignore familiar but harmless stimuli otherwise difficult not to react to
It paves the way for associative conditioning

questions.question: The faster rate of reconditioning after extinction confirms which of the following facts?
options: You can teach an old dog new tricks
We learn better when under pressure
Extinction does not erase original learning
The effects of initial learning always outstrip subsequent learning
questions.reference_answer: 消弱後重新制約速度更快，這就是節省效應（savings effect）。它證明：消弱只是讓 CR 不再表現，並非刪除原始的 CS-US 連結——學習痕跡仍留在大腦中。腳踏車技術沒消失，只是被封存了，一碰就想起來。
concepts: 滅除後的快速再學習（Savings and Reconditioning）

questions.answer_note: 原答案 D 有誤，使用者勘誤為 C（2026-05）。

Our biologically programmed ability to speak must be complimented with interactive language experience in the first year of life
Our biologically programmed ability to speak must be activated with hearing speech in early childhood

questions.question: How does self-awareness contribute to early emotional and social development?
options: Infants start to behave intentionally and learn that their goals may conflict with the goals of others
Infants start to realize that their own feelings and thoughts are more important than those of another person
Infants low in self-awareness are less likely to be egoistic when they are older and therefore make friends more easily
Infants are more likely to express their emotions and thoughts to others

questions.question: Diathesis-stress model: Who is at high risk for disorder?
options: Gene variant + low stress
Gene + high stress
No gene + high stress
None
questions.reference_answer:
一個人是否發展出心理疾病，取決於兩個因素的交互作用：
 Diathesis（素質）：潛在的易感性，如基因、神經系統特徵、早期創傷經驗
Stress（壓力）：生活中實際發生的壓力事件，如失業、失戀、親人死亡等
一當素質高＋壓力高時，最可能觸發疾病
concepts: Diathesis-Stress Model（素質-壓力模型）

questions.question: Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy has the following characteristics except
options: Highly structured sessions
Patient has to do homework such as practicing new skills or new ways or thinking
Concerns with identifying and solving problems the patient wishes to address
Group therapy
None of the above
questions.reference_answer: CBT 的核心特徵：結構化、目標導向、問題解決導向、homework（練習新思考與行為模式）。D（group therapy）是治療形式（format），不是 CBT 的定義要件——CBT 可個別進行也可團體進行，但 group therapy 本身不是 CBT 的特徵。
concepts: 認知行為治療（Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy, CBT） 的核心特徵辨識
questions.key_concepts: 認知行為治療（Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy, CBT） 的核心特徵辨識
questions.ai_hint: except 題找「不是 CBT 特徵」的選項。A/B/C 都是 CBT 核心要素；D group therapy 是形式而非本質，故為例外。E（none of above）錯誤。
questions.answer_note: 原答案 E 有誤，使用者勘誤為 D（2026-05）。
